## MC Hoster 1.3.0

**Download `MC-Hoster.exe` below** and double-click it.

### New: Dark plugins (made by DarkerDawnFR, inside MC Hoster, tick them in tab 5)
- **Dark Shop**: the old DonutSMP `/shop` with End, Nether, Gear and Food, an amount menu (+1/+10/+64), `/sell` (put items in a chest, close it, get paid), `/worth`, `/bal`, `/pay`, `/baltop` (a menu of player heads, richest first) and `/eco` for ops. `/bounty <player> <amount>` puts your money on someone's head, whoever kills them gets it; `/bounty` shows every bounty. Uses EssentialsX/Vault money if you have it, its own money otherwise.
- **Dark AH**: a DonutSMP-style auction house. `/ah`, `/ah sell <price>` (1.5k, 2m work), sort, filter, search, Your Items. Unsold items come back after 48 hours.
- **Dark Discord**: `/discord` sends your Discord link to everyone, `/dc` shows it only to you for 5 seconds. `/dcedit` (ops) changes the link and switches to GUI mode, a chest with a purple dye "Join The Discord!".
- **Dark RTP**: `/rtp` opens a menu (Overworld, Nether, End) and sends you to a safe random spot after a 5-second countdown. `/rtpqueue` or `/rtpq` waits for another player, then sends you both to the same spot.
- **Dark Scoreboard**: the old DonutSMP scoreboard on the side (titled *Test SMP*): money, kills, deaths, bounty, playtime, online and ping, plus the tab list header, footer and names. It reads from all the other Dark plugins. Ops change everything in game with `/dsb edit` (title, lines, tab list, speed); players can hide theirs with `/dsb toggle`.
